question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Stationary
solution:
The correct answer is: **Moving**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stationary **means not moving or not capable of being moved; fixed in one place. (**अचल**)

 
 
• **Example**: *The car was stationary at the traffic light, waiting for it to turn green.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Moving **means in motion; capable of changing position or location. (**गतिशील**)
 
 
• **Example**: *The train was moving swiftly along the tracks, heading towards the next station.*
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym for 'Stationary' is 'Moving'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Immobile: **Unable to move; not capable of changing position. (**स्थिर**)
 
• **Permanent: **Lasting or intended to last indefinitely; not temporary. (**स्थायी**)
 
• **Stable: **Firmly established; not likely to change or fluctuate. (**स्थिर**)
